"""Pure fake-RNA registration ownership; installed Blender remains a separate gate.

The dual-slot fixture follows the independently authored registration probe.
"""

import ast
import types
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SOURCE = ROOT / "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender/registration.py"
NAMES = {
    "_owns_scene_pointer",
    "_owns_scene_registration",
    "_has_scene_registration",
    "register",
    "unregister",
}
tree = ast.parse(SOURCE.read_bytes())
body = [node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in NAMES]
code = compile(ast.Module(body=body, type_ignores=[]), str(SOURCE), "exec")


def fixture():
    events = []
    props = {}

    class SceneMeta(type):
        def __setattr__(self, name, value):
            super().__setattr__(name, value)
            if name in {"mechanical_cad", "mechanical_cad_assembly"}:
                props[name] = value

        def __delattr__(self, name):
            super().__delattr__(name)
            props.pop(name, None)

    class Scene(metaclass=SceneMeta):
        bl_rna = types.SimpleNamespace(properties=props)

    class State:
        is_registered = False
        bl_rna = object()

    class AssemblyState:
        is_registered = False
        bl_rna = object()

    def register_class(cls):
        events.append("register_class")
        cls.is_registered = True

    def unregister_class(cls):
        events.append("unregister_class")
        cls.is_registered = False

    def noop(*args, **kwargs):
        pass

    helpers = types.SimpleNamespace(register=noop, unregister=noop, set_draft_handlers=noop)
    timers = types.SimpleNamespace(is_registered=lambda f: False, register=noop, unregister=noop)
    bpy = types.SimpleNamespace(
        types=types.SimpleNamespace(Scene=Scene),
        utils=types.SimpleNamespace(
            register_class=register_class, unregister_class=unregister_class
        ),
        app=types.SimpleNamespace(
            version=(5, 2, 2), handlers=types.SimpleNamespace(load_post=[]), timers=timers
        ),
    )
    n = {
        "bpy": bpy,
        "MIN_BLENDER_VERSION": (5, 2, 0),
        "CLASSES": (State, AssemblyState),
        "MCAD_State": State,
        "assembly_properties": types.SimpleNamespace(MCAD_AssemblyState=AssemblyState),
        "_SCENE_POINTERS": (("mechanical_cad", State), ("mechanical_cad_assembly", AssemblyState)),
        "PointerProperty": lambda **kwargs: types.SimpleNamespace(fixed_type=kwargs["type"].bl_rna),
        "backend_runtime": types.SimpleNamespace(
            configure_invalidation=noop, new_lifetime=noop, revoke=noop
        ),
        "workspace_ui": helpers,
        "workspace": helpers,
        "assembly_state": types.SimpleNamespace(clear_runtime=noop),
        "document_state": types.SimpleNamespace(_REPLAY_RUNNING=False),
        "_stop_bundle_setup": noop,
        "_start_bundle_setup": noop,
        "_retire_native_jobs": noop,
        "_HISTORY_HANDLERS": (),
        "_on_blend_load": noop,
        "_deferred_rebind": noop,
        "_invalidate_backend_evidence": noop,
        "viewport_sketch": types.SimpleNamespace(
            cancel_active=noop,
            active_session=noop,
            suspend_active=noop,
            suspended_draft=noop,
            draft_recovery_notice=noop,
        ),
    }
    exec(code, n)
    return n, Scene, State, AssemblyState, events


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["mechanical_cad", "mechanical_cad_assembly"])
def test_foreign_slot_rejected_before_register_or_rollback(name):
    n, scene, _state, _assembly, events = fixture()
    foreign = types.SimpleNamespace(fixed_type=object())
    setattr(scene, name, foreign)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="Another Mechanical CAD version"):
        n["register"](rebind=lambda: True)
    n["unregister"]()
    assert getattr(scene, name) is foreign and not events


def test_normal_dual_registration_is_idempotent_and_cleans_only_owned_slots():
    n, scene, _state, _assembly, events = fixture()
    n["register"](rebind=lambda: True)
    assert n["_owns_scene_registration"]()
    count = len(events)
    n["register"](rebind=lambda: True)
    assert len(events) == count
    n["unregister"]()
    assert not hasattr(scene, "mechanical_cad") and not hasattr(scene, "mechanical_cad_assembly")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["mechanical_cad", "mechanical_cad_assembly"])
def test_rollback_preserves_a_slot_replaced_by_foreign_owner(name):
    n, scene, _state, _assembly, _events = fixture()
    foreign = types.SimpleNamespace(fixed_type=object())

    def rebind():
        setattr(scene, name, foreign)
        raise RuntimeError("injected rebind failure")

    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="injected rebind failure"):
        n["register"](rebind=rebind)
    assert getattr(scene, name) is foreign
    other = "mechanical_cad" if name.endswith("assembly") else "mechanical_cad_assembly"
    assert not hasattr(scene, other)


def test_first_class_failure_does_not_delete_preexisting_unrelated_rna():
    n, scene, _state, _assembly, _events = fixture()
    scene.unrelated = object()
    retained = scene.unrelated

    def fail(cls):
        raise RuntimeError("injected class registration failure")

    n["bpy"].utils.register_class = fail
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="class registration failure"):
        n["register"](rebind=lambda: True)
    assert scene.unrelated is retained
    assert not hasattr(scene, "mechanical_cad") and not hasattr(scene, "mechanical_cad_assembly")


def setup_fixture(package="bl_ext.user_default.mechanical_cad"):
    names = {"_poll_bundle_setup", "_stop_bundle_setup", "_start_bundle_setup"}
    nodes = [node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in names]
    events = []
    callbacks = set()

    def register(callback, **kwargs):
        callbacks.add(callback)
        events.append(("timer", kwargs))

    def unregister(callback):
        callbacks.remove(callback)
        events.append(("timer_remove",))

    timers = types.SimpleNamespace(
        is_registered=lambda f: f in callbacks, register=register, unregister=unregister
    )
    module = types.SimpleNamespace(PLATFORM="linux-x64", RELEASE_IDENTITY_BYTES=b"release")

    def load(name):
        events.append(("import", name))
        return module

    def begin(*args):
        events.append(("begin", args))
        return True

    def fail(message):
        events.append(("failure", message))

    def cache(package, **kwargs):
        events.append(("cache", package, kwargs))
        return "/private/cache"

    runtime = types.SimpleNamespace(
        begin_bundled_setup=begin,
        fail_bundled_setup=fail,
        poll_bundled_setup=lambda: True,
        stop_bundled_setup=lambda: events.append(("stop",)),
    )
    n = {
        "__package__": package,
        "sys": types.SimpleNamespace(platform="linux"),
        "__file__": str(SOURCE),
        "Path": Path,
        "importlib": types.SimpleNamespace(import_module=load),
        "backend_runtime": runtime,
        "LAUNCH_CONSTANT_FIELDS": ("PLATFORM", "RELEASE_IDENTITY_BYTES"),
        "bpy": types.SimpleNamespace(
            app=types.SimpleNamespace(timers=timers),
            utils=types.SimpleNamespace(extension_path_user=cache),
        ),
    }
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes, type_ignores=[]), str(SOURCE), "exec"), n)
    return n, events, callbacks, module


def test_true_extension_uses_package_relative_literals_and_persistent_timer():
    n, events, callbacks, _module = setup_fixture()
    n["_start_bundle_setup"]()
    assert events[0] == ("import", n["__package__"] + ".standalone_launch_constants")
    assert events[1] == ("cache", n["__package__"], dict(path="backend_runtime", create=True))
    assert events[2] == (
        "begin",
        (
            str(SOURCE.parent.resolve()),
            "/private/cache",
            dict(PLATFORM="linux-x64", RELEASE_IDENTITY_BYTES=b"release"),
        ),
    )
    assert events[3] == ("timer", dict(first_interval=0.1, persistent=True))
    assert n["_poll_bundle_setup"] in callbacks and n["_poll_bundle_setup"]() == 0.1
    n["backend_runtime"].poll_bundled_setup = lambda: False
    assert n["_poll_bundle_setup"]() is None


def test_legacy_namespace_does_not_start_automatic_preparation():
    n, events, _callbacks, _module = setup_fixture("mechanical_cad_blender")
    n["_start_bundle_setup"]()
    assert events == []


def test_missing_generated_constant_closes_extension_without_worker_or_fallback():
    n, events, callbacks, module = setup_fixture()
    del module.RELEASE_IDENTITY_BYTES
    n["_start_bundle_setup"]()
    assert [event[0] for event in events] == ["import", "failure"]
    assert "Bundled backend setup failed" in events[-1][1] and not callbacks


def test_cancel_failure_does_not_leave_timer_or_escape_native_retirement(capsys):
    n, events, callbacks, _module = setup_fixture()
    n["_start_bundle_setup"]()

    def fail():
        raise RuntimeError("injected setup cleanup failure")

    n["backend_runtime"].stop_bundled_setup = fail
    n["_stop_bundle_setup"]()
    assert not callbacks and events[-1] == ("timer_remove",)
    assert "setup cleanup failure" in capsys.readouterr().out


def test_preferences_draw_has_no_manual_paths_in_bundle_mode():
    prop_tree = ast.parse((SOURCE.parent / "properties.py").read_bytes())
    cls = next(
        n for n in prop_tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "MCAD_Preferences"
    )
    draw = next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "draw")
    from textwrap import wrap

    called = []
    runtime = types.SimpleNamespace(
        bundled_mode=lambda: True, bundle_status=lambda: ("ready", "Bundled backend ready.")
    )
    n = {
        "backend_runtime": runtime,
        "wrap": wrap,
        "assembly_job_ui": types.SimpleNamespace(
            draw_backend_failure=lambda layout, context: False
        ),
    }
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[draw], type_ignores=[]), "<preferences-draw>", "exec"), n)
    credit_labels = []
    credits = types.SimpleNamespace(label=lambda **kwargs: credit_labels.append(kwargs["text"]))
    layout = types.SimpleNamespace(
        prop=lambda obj, key: called.append(key), label=lambda **kwargs: None, box=lambda: credits
    )
    n["draw"](types.SimpleNamespace(layout=layout), None)
    assert called == ["timeout_seconds", "linear_deflection"]
    assert (
        "This software contains paintlib code. paintlib is copyright (c) 1996-2002 "
        "Ulrich von Zadow and other contributors."
    ) in " ".join(credit_labels)
    assert "Licenses and source: MATERIALS.md, licenses/ and sources/ in the ZIP." in credit_labels
    bundled_credits = credit_labels[:]
    called.clear()
    credit_labels.clear()
    runtime.bundled_mode = lambda: False
    n["draw"](types.SimpleNamespace(layout=layout), None)
    assert called == ["project_root", "python_executable", "timeout_seconds", "linear_deflection"]
    assert credit_labels == bundled_credits


def test_actual_lease_quarantine_survives_register_disable_and_reenable(monkeypatch):
    """Real lease/runtime modules and actual registration control flow; fake RNA only."""
    import importlib
    import sys
    import threading

    name = "mcad_quarantined_registration_tests"
    package = sys.modules.setdefault(name, types.ModuleType(name))
    package.__path__ = [str(SOURCE.parent)]
    lease = importlib.import_module(name + ".execution_lease")
    runtime = importlib.import_module(name + ".backend_runtime")
    transport = importlib.import_module(name + ".guarded_transport")
    for key in ("_TOKEN", "_BOUND_TOKEN", "_QUARANTINE"):
        monkeypatch.setattr(lease, key, None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(lease, "_SCOPE", threading.local())
    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "_INVALIDATE", None)
    owner = object()  # No real process/handle is leaked by this regression.
    token = lease.try_acquire()
    with lease.synchronous(token):
        assert lease.bind_transport() == (token, False)
        assert lease.quarantine(token, owner)
    n, _scene, _state, _assembly, _events = fixture()
    n["backend_runtime"] = runtime
    n["_stop_bundle_setup"] = runtime.stop_bundled_setup
    starts = []

    def forbidden_job(*args, **kwargs):
        starts.append(True)
        raise AssertionError("A successor job must not be constructed.")

    monkeypatch.setattr(transport, "GuardedJob", forbidden_job)
    for transition in (
        lambda: n["register"](rebind=lambda: True),
        n["unregister"],
        lambda: n["register"](rebind=lambda: True),
        n["unregister"],
    ):
        transition()
        assert lease._QUARANTINE == (token, owner)
        assert lease.cleanup_message() == lease.QUARANTINE_MESSAGE
        assert lease.is_busy() and lease.try_acquire() is None
        assert not lease.release(token)
        with pytest.raises(transport.GuardedOperationError, match="restart Blender"):
            transport.execute(None, None, owner_token=object(), current_selection=lambda: None)
    assert starts == []


def test_windows_extension_guard_precedes_all_setup_io_and_timer_work():
    n, events, callbacks, _module = setup_fixture()
    n["sys"].platform = "win32"

    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
        pytest.fail("closed Windows registration touched setup paths or timers")

    n["Path"] = forbidden
    n["importlib"].import_module = forbidden
    n["bpy"].utils.extension_path_user = forbidden
    n["backend_runtime"].begin_bundled_setup = forbidden
    n["bpy"].app.timers.is_registered = forbidden
    n["bpy"].app.timers.register = forbidden
    n["_start_bundle_setup"]()
    assert len(events) == 1 and events[0][0] == "failure"
    assert "pending native qualification" in events[0][1]
    assert not callbacks


def test_windows_non_extension_preserves_original_no_setup_return():
    n, events, callbacks, _module = setup_fixture("mechanical_cad_blender")
    n["sys"].platform = "win32"
    n["_start_bundle_setup"]()
    assert events == [] and not callbacks


def test_other_non_windows_platform_keeps_original_setup_sequence():
    n, events, callbacks, _module = setup_fixture()
    n["sys"].platform = "darwin"
    n["_start_bundle_setup"]()
    assert [event[0] for event in events] == ["import", "cache", "begin", "timer"]
    assert callbacks
